simple: Poses as a colleague, manager, bank, or tech support and talks a person into granting access, approving a change, or revealing data.
analogy: A fraudster in a “gas technician” uniform talks his way into your apartment.
quote: Someone called tech support posing as an “employee” and asked to reset MFA
questions: How does tech support verify the identity of someone asking for a password reset?
Is your domain protected against sender spoofing (SPF, DKIM, DMARC)?
